handoffs.message: REG-004 acceptance/compatibility audit complete. Written to services/registry/review_reg004a_qwen_zh.md. Contains: (1) 33-item acceptance checklist across 7 categories, (2) 11-file schema drift mapping, (3) 8 compatibility risks, (4) recommended 6-phase migration sequence. Ready for review.
Review rejected: see services/registry/review_reg004a_codex_zh.md. Audit contains stale reads of the current registry contract/schema and mis-scopes deferred migration work as REG-004 blockers.

REG-004A revised audit complete. Corrected all three Codex review findings: (1) contract.md and registry_entry_schema.json now correctly assessed as already aligned to artifact_state/deployment_summary split, (2) follow-up migration work properly scoped as out-of-REG-004, (3) deployment_stage ownership consistently treated as derived/non-authoritative throughout. All 23 acceptance checks PASS, 0 FAIL, 6 N/A (out of scope). Ready for re-review.

Audit v2 rewritten. All 4 Codex review findings addressed: (1) registry_entry_schema.json correctly read as already having artifact_state + deployment_summary, (2) follow-on migration work separated from REG-004 acceptance scope, (3) deployment_stage ownership consistent throughout — derived in registry, canonical in DEP-001, (4) acceptance matrix now has consistent PASS/FAIL standards with 18 PASS, 0 FAIL within REG-004 contract scope. Ready for re-review.

Codex review approved. Audit v2 now correctly reflects the current registry contract/schema/README, keeps deployment_summary derived-only, and scopes legacy migration as downstream compatibility work for GOV-001, DEP-001, and execution-side follow-up.
